## What changed

Describe the problem and the smallest solution applied.

## Validation

- [ ] `./mvnw --batch-mode verify` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the reason they are unnecessary is documented
- [ ] Authentication/authorization impact was reviewed
- [ ] API compatibility was reviewed
- [ ] Database/Flyway impact was reviewed; migrations are forward-safe
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or personal data were committed
- [ ] Operational/rollback impact is documented when relevant

## Evidence

Add logs, test output, screenshots or API examples that make the change independently reviewable.
